description: This file implements power management (PM) functions for Zephyr RTOS, including CPU power state handling, device suspend/resume, and notifier mechanisms.

methods.name: pm_state_next_get
methods.description: Returns the next power management state info for a given CPU.

methods.name: pm_notifier_register
methods.description: Registers a notifier for power state changes.

methods.name: pm_notifier_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered power state notifier.

methods.name: pm_system_resume
methods.description: Handles system resume from a low power state, including post operations.

methods.name: pm_state_force
methods.description: Forces a specific power state on a CPU.

methods.name: pm_system_suspend
methods.description: Suspends the system into a specified power state, managing device suspend/resume and notifications.
